verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents a first-party vault export covering logins and notes, and a community report confirms export exists as a real workflow. The pack never names the export formats, though, and frames the export as a backup or a transfer to another Bitwarden vault, so whether the data is portable in open formats to other tools is unproven. Missing for 10: documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), evidence that the export covers all data (attachments, passkeys, TOTP seeds, org data), independent hands-on corroboration of leaving to a non-Bitwarden tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your vault data, including logins and notes, to back up important information or transfer to a new Bitwarden vault.
their fix suggestion was 'export data, delete account, recreate, re-import.'
